The Yolo County Superior Court is a city courthouse in Yolo County, California. It is located within the ninth circuit of the United State Court of Appeals. It was constructed in 1864 and rebuilt into a new courthouse with 14 courtrooms in 2015. The court has jurisdiction over criminal, small claims and probation matters, as well as juvenile, civil, family, traffic, and vehicle matters. They provide online services like files, online payment, forms, remote traffic appearances, probate notes, court calendars and many more, so it is optional to go to court for these services. It also provides self-help appointments, remote court appearances and live courthouse view. Every person must follow local rules in this court. Career opportunities are also available. How to search for case information?

Yolo County Superior Court Case Search can be done online using the intelligent search facility offered by this court to find case records. The search can be done in the following ways:

  • Searching by record or case number
  • Searching by First and Last name.

After entering the data, the information will display. If the information does not come, then the case records will be confidential and cannot be displayed online. You have to go to the court and give a request for these types of documents, and then the court will decide whether to provide that information to you or not.
